request: In the footers, put the page number tab at the right margin and the centre tab in the middle
summary: Every footer paragraph gets exactly two tab stops — centred at the middle of the text and right-aligned at the right margin, measured on each file's own margins — and loses any other stop; a footer that already has them is left alone.
assumptions: the right margin and the middle are measured on each section's own text width (page width less the side margins), so files with different margins each get their own positions
every other tab stop of a footer paragraph (its own or its style's) is cleared
a footer shown by sections with different margins sets that file aside (one tab position cannot fit both)
a whole-part change is plain formatting (decision 14.1); no words change
